title: Dorothy and the Cyclone
author: L. Frank Baum
sourceEdition: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz (1900), Project Gutenberg Children's Literature bookshelf

premise.en: A powerful cyclone carries Dorothy and her dog Toto from Kansas into a magical land.
premise.fr: Un puissant cyclone emporte Dorothée et son chien Toto du Kansas vers un pays magique.
premise.es: Un poderoso ciclón lleva a Dorita y a su perro Toto desde Kansas a una tierra mágica.

summary.en: Dorothy lives on a quiet gray farm in Kansas with her dog Toto. When a fierce cyclone lifts her house high into the sky, she lands in a colorful country. With silver shoes and a new friend, she begins her journey to find the Wizard of Oz.
summary.fr: Dorothée vit dans une ferme grise et calme au Kansas avec son chien Toto. Quand un violent cyclone soulève sa maison dans le ciel, elle atterrit dans un pays coloré. Avec des souliers d'argent et un nouvel ami, elle commence son voyage pour trouver le Magicien d'Oz.
summary.es: Dorita vive en una granja gris y tranquila en Kansas con su perro Toto. Cuando un fuerte ciclón levanta su casa por el cielo, aterriza en un país lleno de color. Con zapatos de plata y un nuevo amigo, comienza su viaje para encontrar al Mago de Oz.

tutorNotes.pronunciation: Learners often mispronounce the voiced 'th' sound in frequent words like 'the', 'their', and 'through'. Pay special attention to the vowel sounds in 'cyclone' and 'scarecrow'. Encourage learners to pronounce final consonant clusters distinctly in words like 'field', 'land', and 'ground'.
tutorNotes.grammar: This text reinforces past tense narratives using both regular verbs like 'walked' and 'looked' and frequent irregular verbs like 'was', 'saw', 'said', and 'went'. Short coordinate clauses connected by 'and' or 'but' give learners practice with natural sequence markers. Prepositional phrases indicating direction and location appear throughout each chapter.
tutorNotes.culture: The story opens on the expansive, flat Great Plains of Kansas in the American Midwest, where severe windstorms and tornadoes are a real hazard. The sharp contrast between the bleak, gray prairie and the vibrant magical land reflects classic twentieth-century American fairy tale themes.
tutorNotes.commonErrors: Learners often confuse irregular past forms such as 'fell' and 'felt' or omit subject pronouns when translating from Spanish or French. Ensure correct adjective-before-noun order in phrases like 'yellow brick road' and 'silver shoes'.

question.en: Where did Dorothy live before the cyclone came?
question.fr: Où vivait Dorothée avant l'arrivée du cyclone ?
question.es: ¿Dónde vivía Dorita antes de que llegara el ciclón?

question.en: What did the Good Witch give to Dorothy in the land of the Munchkins?
question.fr: Qu'est-ce que la Bonne Sorcière a donné à Dorothée au pays des Munchkins ?
question.es: ¿Qué le dio la Bruja Buena a Dorita en la tierra de los Munchkins?

question.en: Which road must Dorothy follow to reach the Emerald City?
question.fr: Quelle route Dorothée doit-elle suivre pour atteindre la Cité d'Émeraude ?
question.es: ¿Qué camino debe seguir Dorita para llegar a la Ciudad Esmeralda?

question.en: Why did the Scarecrow decide to travel with Dorothy?
question.fr: Pourquoi l'Épouvantail a-t-il décidé de voyager avec Dorothée ?
question.es: ¿Por qué decidió el Espantapájaros viajar con Dorita?

sentences.text: Dorothy lived in the middle of Kansas.

translation.en: Dorothy lived in the middle of Kansas.
translation.fr: Dorothée vivait au milieu du Kansas.
translation.es: Dorita vivía en medio de Kansas.

sentences.text: She lived with Uncle Henry and Aunt Em.

translation.en: She lived with Uncle Henry and Aunt Em.
translation.fr: Elle vivait avec son oncle Henry et sa tante Em.
translation.es: Vivía con su tío Henry y su tía Em.

sentences.text: Uncle Henry was a hardworking farmer.

translation.en: Uncle Henry was a hardworking farmer.
translation.fr: L'oncle Henry était un fermier travailleur.
translation.es: El tío Henry era un granjero trabajador.

sentences.text: Their wooden house was small and humble.

translation.en: Their wooden house was small and humble.
translation.fr: Leur maison en bois était petite et modeste.
translation.es: Su casa de madera era pequeña y humilde.

sentences.text: They had one room and a small cellar under the floor.

translation.en: They had one room and a small cellar under the floor.
translation.fr: Ils avaient une seule pièce et une petite cave sous le plancher.
translation.es: Tenían una sola habitación y un pequeño sótano bajo el suelo.

sentences.text: The great prairie was flat and dry.

translation.en: The great prairie was flat and dry.
translation.fr: La grande prairie était plate et sèche.
translation.es: La gran pradera era plana y seca.

sentences.text: Not a single tree grew near the little house.

translation.en: Not a single tree grew near the little house.
translation.fr: Pas un seul arbre ne poussait près de la petite maison.
translation.es: Ni un solo árbol crecía cerca de la casita.

sentences.text: The hot summer sun burned the land.

translation.en: The hot summer sun burned the land.
translation.fr: Le chaud soleil d'été brûlait la terre.
translation.es: El cálido sol de verano quemaba la tierra.

sentences.text: The grass was gray and dry.

translation.en: The grass was gray and dry.
translation.fr: L'herbe était grise et sèche.
translation.es: La hierba estaba gris y seca.

sentences.text: Even the wood of the house was gray.

translation.en: Even the wood of the house was gray.
translation.fr: Même le bois de la maison était gris.
translation.es: Incluso la madera de la casa era gris.

sentences.text: Dorothy had a little black dog.

translation.en: Dorothy had a little black dog.
translation.fr: Dorothée avait un petit chien noir.
translation.es: Dorita tenía un perrito negro.

sentences.text: His name was Toto.

translation.en: His name was Toto.
translation.fr: Son nom était Toto.
translation.es: Su nombre era Toto.

sentences.text: Toto had shiny black eyes and soft black hair.

translation.en: Toto had shiny black eyes and soft black hair.
translation.fr: Toto avait des yeux noirs brillants et des poils noirs doux.
translation.es: Toto tenía ojos negros brillantes y pelo negro suave.

sentences.text: He played games with Dorothy every single day.

translation.en: He played games with Dorothy every single day.
translation.fr: Il jouait à des jeux avec Dorothée chaque jour.
translation.es: Jugaba a juegos con Dorita todos los días.

sentences.text: The little dog made Dorothy laugh and smile.

translation.en: The little dog made Dorothy laugh and smile.
translation.fr: Le petit chien faisait rire et sourire Dorothée.
translation.es: El perrito hacía reír y sonreír a Dorita.

sentences.text: Uncle Henry worked hard from early morning until dark night.

translation.en: Uncle Henry worked hard from early morning until dark night.
translation.fr: L'oncle Henry travaillait dur du matin tôt jusqu'à la nuit noire.
translation.es: El tío Henry trabajaba duro desde temprano en la mañana hasta la noche oscura.

sentences.text: He rarely smiled and never laughed aloud.

translation.en: He rarely smiled and never laughed aloud.
translation.fr: Il souriait rarement et ne riait jamais à voix haute.
translation.es: Rara vez sonreía y nunca se reía en voz alta.

sentences.text: Aunt Em was also very quiet and sad.

translation.en: Aunt Em was also very quiet and sad.
translation.fr: La tante Em était aussi très silencieuse et triste.
translation.es: La tía Em también era muy silenciosa y triste.

sentences.text: The dry prairie had taken away her bright smile.

translation.en: The dry prairie had taken away her bright smile.
translation.fr: La prairie sèche avait emporté son sourire éclatant.
translation.es: La pradera seca le había quitado su brillante sonrisa.

sentences.text: Only little Toto brought joy to Dorothy.

translation.en: Only little Toto brought joy to Dorothy.
translation.fr: Seul le petit Toto apportait de la joie à Dorothée.
translation.es: Solo el pequeño Toto le daba alegría a Dorita.

sentences.text: One afternoon, the sky turned very dark and cold.

translation.en: One afternoon, the sky turned very dark and cold.
translation.fr: Un après-midi, le ciel devint très sombre et froid.
translation.es: Una tarde, el cielo se volvió muy oscuro y frío.

sentences.text: A strong wind blew from the north.

translation.en: A strong wind blew from the north.
translation.fr: Un vent violent soufflait du nord.
translation.es: Un viento fuerte soplaba desde el norte.

sentences.text: Uncle Henry stood outside and looked at the black clouds.

translation.en: Uncle Henry stood outside and looked at the black clouds.
translation.fr: L'oncle Henry se tenait dehors et regardait les nuages noirs.
translation.es: El tío Henry se quedó afuera y miró las nubes negras.

sentences.text: He heard a low sound across the empty plains.

translation.en: He heard a low sound across the empty plains.
translation.fr: Il entendit un bruit sourd à travers les plaines vides.
translation.es: Oyó un sonido grave a través de las llanuras vacías.

sentences.text: "A great cyclone is coming!" Uncle Henry shouted loudly.

translation.en: "A great cyclone is coming!" Uncle Henry shouted loudly.
translation.fr: « Un grand cyclone arrive ! » cria très fort l'oncle Henry.
translation.es: —¡Viene un gran ciclón! —gritó con fuerza el tío Henry.

sentences.text: "Run to the cellar right now!" Aunt Em cried.

translation.en: "Run to the cellar right now!" Aunt Em cried.
translation.fr: « Courez à la cave tout de suite ! » s'écria la tante Em.
translation.es: —¡Corran al sótano ahora mismo! —exclamó la tía Em.

sentences.text: She pulled open the small wooden door in the floor.

translation.en: She pulled open the small wooden door in the floor.
translation.fr: Elle ouvrit la petite trappe en bois dans le plancher.
translation.es: Abrió la pequeña puerta de madera en el suelo.

sentences.text: Aunt Em climbed down quickly into the dark shelter.

translation.en: Aunt Em climbed down quickly into the dark shelter.
translation.fr: La tante Em descendit rapidement dans le sombre abri.
translation.es: La tía Em bajó de prisa al refugio oscuro.

sentences.text: Dorothy ran across the room to catch Toto.

translation.en: Dorothy ran across the room to catch Toto.
translation.fr: Dorothée courut à travers la pièce pour attraper Toto.
translation.es: Dorita corrió por la habitación para atrapar a Toto.

sentences.text: The little dog was frightened by the terrible wind.

translation.en: The little dog was frightened by the terrible wind.
translation.fr: Le petit chien était effrayé par le vent terrible.
translation.es: El perrito estaba asustado por el viento terrible.

sentences.text: He ran under the bed and hid in the shadow.

translation.en: He ran under the bed and hid in the shadow.
translation.fr: Il courut sous le lit et se cacha dans l'ombre.
translation.es: Corrió debajo de la cama y se escondió en la sombra.

sentences.text: Dorothy picked him up safely in her arms.

translation.en: Dorothy picked him up safely in her arms.
translation.fr: Dorothée le prit prudemment dans ses bras.
translation.es: Dorita lo tomó con cuidado en sus brazos.

sentences.text: Suddenly, a loud crash shook the entire building.

translation.en: Suddenly, a loud crash shook the entire building.
translation.fr: Soudain, un bruit fracassant secoua tout le bâtiment.
translation.es: De repente, un fuerte estruendo sacudió todo el edificio.

sentences.text: A mighty blast of air struck the house.

translation.en: A mighty blast of air struck the house.
translation.fr: Une puissante rafale d'air frappa la maison.
translation.es: Una ráfaga de aire poderosa golpeó la casa.

sentences.text: The house rose slowly up into the wild sky.

translation.en: The house rose slowly up into the wild sky.
translation.fr: La maison monta lentement dans le ciel déchaîné.
translation.es: La casa se elevó lentamente hacia el cielo furioso.

sentences.text: It spun around and around in the violent air.

translation.en: It spun around and around in the violent air.
translation.fr: Elle tournoya encore et encore dans l'air violent.
translation.es: Giró y giró en el aire violento.

sentences.text: The house flew high above the dark gray clouds.

translation.en: The house flew high above the dark gray clouds.
translation.fr: La maison vola haut au-dessus des nuages gris foncé.
translation.es: La casa voló muy alto sobre las nubes grises y oscuras.

sentences.text: Dorothy held Toto tight against her warm chest.

translation.en: Dorothy held Toto tight against her warm chest.
translation.fr: Dorothée serrait fort Toto contre sa poitrine chaude.
translation.es: Dorita apretó a Toto contra su pecho cálido.

sentences.text: The strong wind carried them through the empty air.

translation.en: The strong wind carried them through the empty air.
translation.fr: Le vent puissant les transportait à travers l'air vide.
translation.es: El viento fuerte los llevó por el aire vacío.

sentences.text: It felt like riding a boat on a stormy river.

translation.en: It felt like riding a boat on a stormy river.
translation.fr: C'était comme voguer sur un bateau au milieu d'un fleuve agité.
translation.es: Se sentía como viajar en un bote sobre un río tormentoso.

sentences.text: Many long hours passed inside the floating house.

translation.en: Many long hours passed inside the floating house.
translation.fr: Plusieurs longues heures passèrent à l'intérieur de la maison volante.
translation.es: Pasaron muchas horas largas dentro de la casa flotante.

sentences.text: The strange rocking motion became gentle and steady.

translation.en: The strange rocking motion became gentle and steady.
translation.fr: L'étrange balancement devint doux et régulier.
translation.es: El extraño balanceo se volvió suave y constante.

sentences.text: Dorothy crawled onto her soft little bed.

translation.en: Dorothy crawled onto her soft little bed.
translation.fr: Dorothée rampa sur son petit lit douillet.
translation.es: Dorita gateó hasta su suave camita.

sentences.text: She closed her eyes and soon fell fast asleep.

translation.en: She closed her eyes and soon fell fast asleep.
translation.fr: Elle ferma les yeux et s'endormit bientôt profondément.
translation.es: Cerró los ojos y pronto se quedó profundamente dormida.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Land of the Munchkins

sentences.text: A sudden shock woke Dorothy from her deep sleep.

translation.en: A sudden shock woke Dorothy from her deep sleep.
translation.fr: Une secousse soudaine réveilla Dorothée de son profond sommeil.
translation.es: Una sacudida repentina despertó a Dorita de su sueño profundo.

sentences.text: The house had stopped moving through the sky.

translation.en: The house had stopped moving through the sky.
translation.fr: La maison avait cessé de bouger à travers le ciel.
translation.es: La casa había dejado de moverse por el cielo.

sentences.text: Bright sunshine filled the open window of the room.

translation.en: Bright sunshine filled the open window of the room.
translation.fr: Un soleil radieux éclairait la fenêtre ouverte de la pièce.
translation.es: La luz brillante del sol llenó la ventana abierta del cuarto.

sentences.text: Toto barked happily and ran to the front door.

translation.en: Toto barked happily and ran to the front door.
translation.fr: Toto aboya joyeusement et courut vers la porte d'entrée.
translation.es: Toto ladró alegremente y corrió a la puerta principal.

sentences.text: Dorothy walked to the open door and looked outside.

translation.en: Dorothy walked to the open door and looked outside.
translation.fr: Dorothée marcha vers la porte ouverte et regarda dehors.
translation.es: Dorita caminó hacia la puerta abierta y miró afuera.

sentences.text: She gasped with wonder at the lovely view.

translation.en: She gasped with wonder at the lovely view.
translation.fr: Elle eut le souffle coupé d'admiration devant cette vue magnifique.
translation.es: Se quedó sin aliento ante la hermosa vista.

sentences.text: The country was green, fresh, and full of life.

translation.en: The country was green, fresh, and full of life.
translation.fr: Le pays était vert, frais et plein de vie.
translation.es: El país era verde, fresco y lleno de vida.

sentences.text: Tall trees bore rich fruits of many bright colors.

translation.en: Tall trees bore rich fruits of many bright colors.
translation.fr: De grands arbres portaient des fruits abondants aux couleurs vives.
translation.es: Altos árboles daban frutos ricos de muchos colores vivos.

sentences.text: Lovely birds sang sweet songs among the green branches.

translation.en: Lovely birds sang sweet songs among the green branches.
translation.fr: De jolis oiseaux chantaient de douces chansons parmi les branches vertes.
translation.es: Hermosos pájaros cantaban dulces canciones entre las ramas verdes.

sentences.text: Dorothy saw a group of strange people coming toward her.

translation.en: Dorothy saw a group of strange people coming toward her.
translation.fr: Dorothée vit un groupe d'étranges personnes venir vers elle.
translation.es: Dorita vio a un grupo de personas extrañas venir hacia ella.

sentences.text: They were not tall like grown men in Kansas.

translation.en: They were not tall like grown men in Kansas.
translation.fr: Ils n'étaient pas grands comme les hommes adultes du Kansas.
translation.es: No eran altos como los hombres adultos de Kansas.

sentences.text: They were small, like children, but dressed like adults.

translation.en: They were small, like children, but dressed like adults.
translation.fr: Ils étaient petits comme des enfants, mais habillés comme des adultes.
translation.es: Eran pequeños, como niños, pero vestidos como adultos.

sentences.text: The men wore round blue hats with tall peaks.

translation.en: The men wore round blue hats with tall peaks.
translation.fr: Les hommes portaient des chapeaux bleus ronds aux pointes hautes.
translation.es: Los hombres llevaban sombreros azules redondos con puntas altas.

sentences.text: An elderly woman walked with the little men.

translation.en: An elderly woman walked with the little men.
translation.fr: Une femme âgée marchait avec les petits hommes.
translation.es: Una mujer anciana caminaba con los hombres pequeños.

sentences.text: She wore a beautiful white gown sprinkled with tiny stars.

translation.en: She wore a beautiful white gown sprinkled with tiny stars.
translation.fr: Elle portait une belle robe blanche parsemée de petites étoiles.
translation.es: Llevaba un hermoso vestido blanco salpicado de estrellas diminutas.

sentences.text: Her hair was white, and her face was kind and gentle.

translation.en: Her hair was white, and her face was kind and gentle.
translation.fr: Ses cheveux étaient blancs, et son visage était doux et bienveillant.
translation.es: Su cabello era blanco y su rostro era amable y dulce.

sentences.text: She walked straight toward Dorothy with a warm smile.

translation.en: She walked straight toward Dorothy with a warm smile.
translation.fr: Elle marcha droit vers Dorothée avec un sourire chaleureux.
translation.es: Caminó directamente hacia Dorita con una sonrisa cálida.

sentences.text: "Welcome to the land of the Munchkins," the woman said.

translation.en: "Welcome to the land of the Munchkins," the woman said.
translation.fr: « Bienvenue au pays des Munchkins », dit la femme.
translation.es: —Bienvenida al país de los Munchkins —dijo la mujer.

sentences.text: "You have killed the Wicked Witch of the East."

translation.en: "You have killed the Wicked Witch of the East."
translation.fr: « Vous avez tué la Méchante Sorcière de l'Est. »
translation.es: —Has matado a la Bruja Mala del Este.

sentences.text: "You have freed these good people from long slavery."

translation.en: "You have freed these good people from long slavery."
translation.fr: « Vous avez libéré ces braves gens d'un long esclavage. »
translation.es: —Has liberado a esta buena gente de una larga esclavitud.

sentences.text: "I have killed nobody," Dorothy replied with surprise.

translation.en: "I have killed nobody," Dorothy replied with surprise.
translation.fr: « Je n'ai tué personne », répondit Dorothée avec surprise.
translation.es: —Yo no he matado a nadie —respondió Dorita con sorpresa.

sentences.text: "My house fell upon her," the Good Witch explained kindly.

translation.en: "My house fell upon her," the Good Witch explained kindly.
translation.fr: « Votre maison est tombée sur elle », expliqua gentiment la Bonne Sorcière.
translation.es: —Tu casa cayó sobre ella —explicó amablemente la Bruja Buena.

sentences.text: Dorothy looked down and saw two feet under the house.

translation.en: Dorothy looked down and saw two feet under the house.
translation.fr: Dorothée baissa les yeux et vit deux pieds sous la maison.
translation.es: Dorita miró hacia abajo y vio dos pies debajo de la casa.

sentences.text: The feet wore pretty silver shoes with pointed toes.

translation.en: The feet wore pretty silver shoes with pointed toes.
translation.fr: Les pieds portaient de jolis souliers d'argent aux bouts pointus.
translation.es: Los pies llevaban bonitos zapatos de plata con puntas afiladas.

sentences.text: The Good Witch took the silver shoes from the dust.

translation.en: The Good Witch took the silver shoes from the dust.
translation.fr: La Bonne Sorcière ramassa les souliers d'argent dans la poussière.
translation.es: La Bruja Buena recogió los zapatos de plata del polvo.

sentences.text: She gave the shining shoes to the little girl.

translation.en: She gave the shining shoes to the little girl.
translation.fr: Elle donna les souliers brillants à la petite fille.
translation.es: Le dio los zapatos brillantes a la niña.

sentences.text: "Put them on your feet," the kind witch said.

translation.en: "Put them on your feet," the kind witch said.
translation.fr: « Mettez-les à vos pieds », dit la gentille sorcière.
translation.es: —Póntelos en los pies —dijo la bruja buena.

sentences.text: "These magic shoes will protect you on your journey."

translation.en: "These magic shoes will protect you on your journey."
translation.fr: « Ces souliers magiques vous protégeront pendant votre voyage. »
translation.es: —Estos zapatos mágicos te protegerán en tu viaje.

sentences.text: "I must return home to Kansas," Dorothy said.

translation.en: "I must return home to Kansas," Dorothy said.
translation.fr: « Je dois rentrer chez moi au Kansas », dit Dorothée.
translation.es: —Debo volver a casa en Kansas —dijo Dorita.

sentences.text: "My Aunt Em and Uncle Henry will worry about me."

translation.en: "My Aunt Em and Uncle Henry will worry about me."
translation.fr: « Ma tante Em et mon oncle Henry vont s'inquiéter pour moi. »
translation.es: —Mi tía Em y mi tío Henry se van a preocupar por mí.

sentences.text: "The road to Kansas is very long," the witch replied.

translation.en: "The road to Kansas is very long," the witch replied.
translation.fr: « Le chemin du Kansas est très long », répondit la sorcière.
translation.es: —El camino a Kansas es muy largo —respondió la bruja.

sentences.text: "You must ask the great Wizard of Oz for help."

translation.en: "You must ask the great Wizard of Oz for help."
translation.fr: « Vous devez demander de l'aide au grand Magicien d'Oz. »
translation.es: —Debes pedir ayuda al gran Mago de Oz.

sentences.text: "Where does the Wizard live?" Dorothy asked quickly.

translation.en: "Where does the Wizard live?" Dorothy asked quickly.
translation.fr: « Où habite le Magicien ? » demanda rapidement Dorothée.
translation.es: ¿Dónde vive el Mago? —preguntó Dorita de prisa.

sentences.text: "He lives far away in the Emerald City," the witch answered.

translation.en: "He lives far away in the Emerald City," the witch answered.
translation.fr: « Il vit loin d'ici, dans la Cité d'Émeraude », répondit la sorcière.
translation.es: —Vive muy lejos, en la Ciudad Esmeralda —respondió la bruja.

sentences.text: "Just follow the road made of yellow brick."

translation.en: "Just follow the road made of yellow brick."
translation.fr: « Suivez simplement la route pavée de briques jaunes. »
translation.es: —Solo sigue el camino de ladrillos amarillos.

sentences.text: The Good Witch kissed Dorothy gently on her forehead.

translation.en: The Good Witch kissed Dorothy gently on her forehead.
translation.fr: La Bonne Sorcière embrassa doucement Dorothée sur le front.
translation.es: La Bruja Buena besó suavemente a Dorita en la frente.

sentences.text: A small round mark remained where the witch had kissed her.

translation.en: A small round mark remained where the witch had kissed her.
translation.fr: Une petite marque ronde resta là où la sorcière l'avait embrassée.
translation.es: Una pequeña marca redonda quedó donde la bruja la había besado.

sentences.text: "No wicked creature will dare to harm you now," she said.

translation.en: "No wicked creature will dare to harm you now," she said.
translation.fr: « Aucune créature malfaisante n'osera vous faire de mal désormais », dit-elle.
translation.es: —Ninguna criatura malvada se atreverá a lastimarte ahora —dijo ella.

sentences.text: The Munchkins bowed low and said farewell with joyful smiles.

translation.en: The Munchkins bowed low and said farewell with joyful smiles.
translation.fr: Les Munchkins s'inclinèrent profondément et lui dirent adieu avec de joyeux sourires.
translation.es: Los Munchkins hicieron una reverencia y se despidieron con sonrisas alegres.

sentences.text: Dorothy put on the silver shoes and prepared to leave.

translation.en: Dorothy put on the silver shoes and prepared to leave.
translation.fr: Dorothée enfila les souliers d'argent et se prépara à partir.
translation.es: Dorita se puso los zapatos de plata y se preparó para partir.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The Scarecrow on the Road

sentences.text: Dorothy and Toto started walking down the yellow brick road.

translation.en: Dorothy and Toto started walking down the yellow brick road.
translation.fr: Dorothée et Toto commencèrent à marcher sur la route de briques jaunes.
translation.es: Dorita y Toto empezaron a caminar por el camino de ladrillos amarillos.

sentences.text: The bright yellow stones shone like gold in the sun.

translation.en: The bright yellow stones shone like gold in the sun.
translation.fr: Les pierres jaune vif brillaient comme de l'or au soleil.
translation.es: Las piedras amarillas y brillantes resplandecían como oro al sol.

sentences.text: Clean white fences lined both sides of the peaceful path.

translation.en: Clean white fences lined both sides of the peaceful path.
translation.fr: De blanches barrières propres bordaient les deux côtés du chemin paisible.
translation.es: Cercas blancas y limpias bordeaban ambos lados del camino tranquilo.

sentences.text: Neat blue houses stood among fields of green corn.

translation.en: Neat blue houses stood among fields of green corn.
translation.fr: De coquettes maisons bleues s'élevaient parmi des champs de maïs vert.
translation.es: Casas azules y ordenadas se alzaban entre campos de maíz verde.

sentences.text: Dorothy walked for many miles through the pleasant country.

translation.en: Dorothy walked for many miles through the pleasant country.
translation.fr: Dorothée marcha pendant plusieurs kilomètres à travers cette agréable contrée.
translation.es: Dorita caminó muchas millas por el agradable campo.

sentences.text: Her silver shoes made a cheerful sound upon the bricks.

translation.en: Her silver shoes made a cheerful sound upon the bricks.
translation.fr: Ses souliers d'argent faisaient un bruit joyeux sur les briques.
translation.es: Sus zapatos de plata hacían un sonido alegre sobre los ladrillos.

sentences.text: Soon, she stopped to rest beside a large cornfield.

translation.en: Soon, she stopped to rest beside a large cornfield.
translation.fr: Bientôt, elle s'arrêta pour se reposer près d'un grand champ de maïs.
translation.es: Pronto, se detuvo a descansar junto a un gran maizal.

sentences.text: She sat down upon a wooden bench near the road.

translation.en: She sat down upon a wooden bench near the road.
translation.fr: Elle s'assit sur un banc en bois près de la route.
translation.es: Se sentó en un banco de madera cerca del camino.

sentences.text: Inside the field, Dorothy noticed a tall wooden pole.

translation.en: Inside the field, Dorothy noticed a tall wooden pole.
translation.fr: À l'intérieur du champ, Dorothée remarqua un grand poteau en bois.
translation.es: Dentro del campo, Dorita notó un poste alto de madera.

sentences.text: A strange figure was tied to the top of it.

translation.en: A strange figure was tied to the top of it.
translation.fr: Une silhouette étrange était attachée à son sommet.
translation.es: Una figura extraña estaba atada en la parte superior.

sentences.text: It was a Scarecrow made to frighten the hungry birds.

translation.en: It was a Scarecrow made to frighten the hungry birds.
translation.fr: C'était un Épouvantail conçu pour effrayer les oiseaux affamés.
translation.es: Era un Espantapájaros hecho para asustar a los pájaros hambrientos.

sentences.text: His blue cloth head was painted with eyes and a mouth.

translation.en: His blue cloth head was painted with eyes and a mouth.
translation.fr: Sa tête en tissu bleu était peinte avec des yeux et une bouche.
translation.es: Su cabeza de tela azul estaba pintada con ojos y boca.

sentences.text: The body of the Scarecrow was stuffed with dry straw.

translation.en: The body of the Scarecrow was stuffed with dry straw.
translation.fr: Le corps de l'Épouvantail était rempli de paille sèche.
translation.es: El cuerpo del Espantapájaros estaba relleno de paja seca.

sentences.text: He wore an old blue suit and a pointed hat.

translation.en: He wore an old blue suit and a pointed hat.
translation.fr: Il portait un vieux costume bleu et un chapeau pointu.
translation.es: Llevaba un viejo traje azul y un sombrero puntiagudo.

sentences.text: Dorothy looked closely at his curious painted face.

translation.en: Dorothy looked closely at his curious painted face.
translation.fr: Dorothée regarda attentivement son curieux visage peint.
translation.es: Dorita miró de cerca su curioso rostro pintado.

sentences.text: Suddenly, one of the painted eyes winked at her.

translation.en: Suddenly, one of the painted eyes winked at her.
translation.fr: Soudain, un des yeux peints lui fit un clin d'œil.
translation.es: De pronto, uno de los ojos pintados le guiñó el ojo.

sentences.text: "Good day," the Scarecrow said in a husky voice.

translation.en: "Good day," the Scarecrow said in a husky voice.
translation.fr: « Bonjour », dit l'Épouvantail d'une voix rauque.
translation.es: —Buenos días —dijo el Espantapájaros con voz ronca.

sentences.text: Dorothy walked into the field with great wonder.

translation.en: Dorothy walked into the field with great wonder.
translation.fr: Dorothée entra dans le champ avec un grand étonnement.
translation.es: Dorita entró al campo con gran asombro.

sentences.text: "Did you just speak to me?" Dorothy asked.

translation.en: "Did you just speak to me?" Dorothy asked.
translation.fr: « Est-ce que tu viens de me parler ? » demanda Dorothée.
translation.es: —¿Acabas de hablarme? —preguntó Dorita.

sentences.text: "Certainly," the Scarecrow answered with a friendly nod.

translation.en: "Certainly," the Scarecrow answered with a friendly nod.
translation.fr: « Certainement », répondit l'Épouvantail avec un hochement de tête amical.
translation.es: —Por supuesto —respondió el Espantapájaros con un saludo amistoso.

sentences.text: "Can you please help me down?" the Scarecrow asked.

translation.en: "Can you please help me down?" the Scarecrow asked.
translation.fr: « Peux-tu m'aider à descendre, s'il te plaît ? » demanda l'Épouvantail.
translation.es: —¿Puedes ayudarme a bajar, por favor? —preguntó el Espantapájaros.

sentences.text: "This pole is stuck firmly in my back."

translation.en: "This pole is stuck firmly in my back."
translation.fr: « Ce poteau est solidement coincé dans mon dos. »
translation.es: —Este poste está clavado firmemente en mi espalda.

sentences.text: Dorothy reached up with both hands and lifted him off.

translation.en: Dorothy reached up with both hands and lifted him off.
translation.fr: Dorothée leva ses deux mains et le décrocha.
translation.es: Dorita levantó ambas manos y lo descolgó.

sentences.text: Being stuffed with straw, he was very light to hold.

translation.en: Being stuffed with straw, he was very light to hold.
translation.fr: Étant rempli de paille, il était très léger à porter.
translation.es: Al estar relleno de paja, era muy liviano de sostener.

sentences.text: The Scarecrow stretched his arms and legs with relief.

translation.en: The Scarecrow stretched his arms and legs with relief.
translation.fr: L'Épouvantail étira ses bras et ses jambes avec soulagement.
translation.es: El Espantapájaros estiró los brazos y las piernas con alivio.

sentences.text: "Thank you very much, my little friend," he said.

translation.en: "Thank you very much, my little friend," he said.
translation.fr: « Merci beaucoup, ma petite amie », dit-il.
translation.es: —Muchas gracias, mi pequeña amiga —dijo.

sentences.text: "I feel like a brand new man upon the ground."

translation.en: "I feel like a brand new man upon the ground."
translation.fr: « Je me sens comme un homme tout neuf sur le sol. »
translation.es: —Me siento como un hombre nuevo en el suelo.

sentences.text: Toto barked with suspicion and smelled the dry straw.

translation.en: Toto barked with suspicion and smelled the dry straw.
translation.fr: Toto aboya avec méfiance et renifla la paille sèche.
translation.es: Toto ladró con desconfianza y olió la paja seca.

sentences.text: "Who are you and where are you going?" the Scarecrow asked.

translation.en: "Who are you and where are you going?" the Scarecrow asked.
translation.fr: « Qui es-tu et où vas-tu ? » demanda l'Épouvantail.
translation.es: —¿Quién eres y adónde vas? —preguntó el Espantapájaros.

sentences.text: "I am Dorothy, and I am going to the Emerald City."

translation.en: "I am Dorothy, and I am going to the Emerald City."
translation.fr: « Je suis Dorothée, et je vais à la Cité d'Émeraude. »
translation.es: —Soy Dorita y voy a la Ciudad Esmeralda.

sentences.text: "I will ask the great Wizard of Oz to send me home."

translation.en: "I will ask the great Wizard of Oz to send me home."
translation.fr: « Je vais demander au grand Magicien d'Oz de me renvoyer chez moi. »
translation.es: —Le pediré al gran Mago de Oz que me mande a casa.

sentences.text: "Do you think the Wizard could give me a brain?" he asked.

translation.en: "Do you think the Wizard could give me a brain?" he asked.
translation.fr: « Penses-tu que le Magicien pourrait me donner un cerveau ? » demanda-t-il.
translation.es: —¿Crees que el Mago podría darme un cerebro? —preguntó.

sentences.text: "My head is only filled with cheap straw, you see."

translation.en: "My head is only filled with cheap straw, you see."
translation.fr: « Vois-tu, ma tête est seulement remplie de paille ordinaire. »
translation.es: —Como ves, mi cabeza solo está llena de paja barata.

sentences.text: "I do not know anything because I have no brain."

translation.en: "I do not know anything because I have no brain."
translation.fr: « Je ne sais rien parce que je n'ai pas de cerveau. »
translation.es: —No sé nada porque no tengo cerebro.

sentences.text: "Come with me," Dorothy said with a warm smile.

translation.en: "Come with me," Dorothy said with a warm smile.
translation.fr: « Viens avec moi », dit Dorothée avec un sourire chaleureux.
translation.es: —Ven conmigo —dijo Dorita con una cálida sonrisa.

sentences.text: "We can ask the great Wizard together."

translation.en: "We can ask the great Wizard together."
translation.fr: « Nous pourrons demander au grand Magicien ensemble. »
translation.es: —Podemos pedirle al gran Mago juntos.

sentences.text: "I will gladly go with you," the happy Scarecrow replied.

translation.en: "I will gladly go with you," the happy Scarecrow replied.
translation.fr: « Je viendrai volontiers avec toi », répondit le joyeux Épouvantail.
translation.es: —Iré con gusto contigo —respondió el alegre Espantapájaros.

sentences.text: They stepped back onto the yellow brick road toward Oz.

translation.en: They stepped back onto the yellow brick road toward Oz.
translation.fr: Ils retournèrent sur la route de briques jaunes en direction d'Oz.
translation.es: Regresaron al camino de ladrillos amarillos rumbo a Oz.
